$schema: 2-pt grid indexed numerically (t.space[6] = 12), derived from the current app's padding/margin/gap histogram (12, 8, 10, 6, 16, 4, 14, 2, 20, 24, 32). Radii 3/9/10 fold into neighbours.

zIndex.$description: A layer that can open FROM another must outrank it: drawer < sheet < modal < popover < confirm < toast.

elevation.$description: Native: shadowColor is the opaque token; opacity/radius/offset here. Android uses elevation. Web uses the rgba shadow token.
